newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SUPER GROUP BUYS 50 PCT STAKE IN GLASS FIRM.
newsitem.headline: SUPER GROUP BUYS 50 PCT STAKE IN GLASS FIRM.

text.p: Super Group Ltd said on Tuesday agreement had been reached to buy a 50 percent stake in automotive glass retailer, Glastam Ltd, which trades under the name Glasfit.
Super Group said the purchase would provide additional growth opportunites for its vehicle maintenance activities, motor dealerships and short-term insurance business.

The transaction will see Super Group subscribe for 50 percent of the shares in a new company, Newco, to be formed. Payment will be made by Glastam subscribing for the remaining 50 percent of the shares in Newco.
Super Group said it had an option to buy Glastam's 50 percent stake in Newco at a price to be determined by future profitability and within 30 months from the transaction date.
